2000.why: It drew about one and a half times the average car's complaints in its first 3 years, most about engine. 2000 is one of the weaker years of a model that usually draws about three-quarters as many complaints as the average car.
2000.pln: about one and a half times the average car's complaints
td: Engine
Start it cold if you can. Listen for ticking or knocking, and watch for smoke, a rough idle or a check-engine light.
Wipers & visibility
Run the wipers, washers, defrost and mirror controls.
Electrical
Try every light, screen, window, lock and power feature, and watch the dash for warning lights.
Steering
Turn lock to lock and drive straight: no clunks, whine, wander or heavy spots, and no steering warning.
Tires
Check the tread is even across each tire, with no bulges, and note the tire date codes.
